legal_basis.regulation_observation: CMS deems hospitals operated by an Indian Health Program, as defined by section 4(12) of the Indian Health Care Improvement Act, to be in compliance with Part 180.
legal_basis.statute_observation: The definition of Indian Health Program includes a tribal health program; a tribal health program is a tribe or tribal organization operating a health facility funded in whole or part by IHS through an ISDEAA contract or compact.
